title: Puffer mid-jump in a foil booth

tokens.v: She is caught at the top of a jump inside the foil booth, knees tucked, braids flying, the tangerine cropped puffer open over a black sports bra, with black high-waisted leggings and black trainers. The crinkled silver walls throw hundreds of cool highlights across the glossy nylon. 24mm from low, full length, frozen with flash.
